crossRefs.note: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and…
Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink…
Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of…
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom…
In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That…
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.
Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water…

translations.web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
translations.bsb: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
